content:
maya-sec: FYI found CVE mention for sentencepiece 0.1.94 -> potential DoS when streaming tokenization in vLLM batches. Affects Dedicated + Private only.

junaid-ml: thanks — is the exploit local only or remote?

maya-sec: looks local to process memory but can be triggered via crafted input on inference endpoints (customer prompts). Attack complexity: low -> treat as high-risk for Dedicated.

sam-infra: tagging @priya-plat — do we have a config that exposes direct tokenization to user payloads?

priya-plat: no direct expose, vLLM does tokenization server-side. But some customers pass raw text that hits the tokenizer path. We have telemetry: ~12 Dedicated clusters running unaffected model versions, 4 clusters using older wheel.

leo-oncall: is there a patch out?

maya-sec: upstream released 0.1.95 with a fix. No advisory for Triton/Flash kernels here. Also saw an adjacent protobuf parsing CVE but lower priority.

deploy-bot: New CVE ticket created: CVE-2026-XXXXX (sentencepiece) — severity HIGH. Assigned to sam-infra.

sam-infra: plan proposal: 1) quick patch job: build wheel with 0.1.95, smoke test on canary cluster; 2) push hotfix to Dedicated clusters in maintenance window; 3) schedule Private customer notifications + recommended upgrade. Anyone object? :thinking_face:

junaid-ml: we should confirm model behavior unchanged. Tokenization diffs can cause eval regressions. I can run a diff on our canned prompts and spot-check SLOs.

priya-plat: please include canary with traffic mirroring not shadowing (we need real load). I'll set up mirroring to canary-3.

maya-sec: also update RBAC audit: ensure deploy service account used for patching is logged to KMS-access audit logs. We should not allow fallback to customer keys during hotpatch.

sam-infra: noted. I'll add a one-line check in the rollout playbook: `aws kms:Decrypt` calls must be present in audit stream for the deploy SA.

leo-oncall: ETA for canary smoke?

sam-infra: building wheel now, expect canary by +45m.

junaid-ml: running tokenization diff job now — will post results in thread.

maya-sec: triage decision: HIGH for Dedicated and Private with older wheel; MEDIUM for Hosted since we run newer snapshot there. Action items: - patch rollout (sam-infra) - eval regression run (junaid-ml) - customer comms (priya-plat) - KMS/audit check (maya-sec)

deploy-bot: Rollout task created: RB-7891. Linked to CVE-2026-XXXXX.

priya-plat: I'll draft a short advisory: what happened, who is affected, mitigation steps (upgrade, temporary rate-limiting).

maya-sec: also add fallback policy: if rollback needed, route to older model variant that tokenizes via embedded tokenizer (slower) not affected. sam-infra, can you confirm variant exists?

sam-infra: yes, variant `model-v2-tokenizer-embedded` exists and is compatible. I can wire fallback in the routing policy.

junaid-ml: diff results: 0.3% tokenization mismatch on edge cases; no stat sig change in top-level evals after small sample. Looks safe but continue monitoring for regressions for 48h post-rollout.

maya-sec: thanks — proceed with canary -> staged rollouts. Keep this thread updated with timestamps. If deploy hits errors, @leo-oncall will escalate.

leo-oncall: ack. I'll be on standby for the maintenance window. :heavy_check_mark: 

sam-infra: starting canary deploy now: command: ```helm upgrade inference-runtime -f values-canary.yaml --set sentencepiece.image=sentencepiece:0.1.95-canary``` watching logs.

maya-sec: good. after successful canary, schedule 2-hour staged push across Dedicated clusters with 15m gaps.

deploy-bot: Canary passed health checks at 1718035120.

sam-infra: rolling to first Dedicated cluster now. will post completion ts.

maya-sec: documenting postmortem template in the ticket, include timeline and KMS audit snippet.

priya-plat: advisory draft posted to doc: https://redwood.internal/advisories/CVE-2026-XXXXX (internal link).
